retry_policy.manual_retry_policy: At most one manually initiated retry for infrastructure failure; preserve every attempt and accumulate all costs and durations. Model failures are retained as zero-quality outcomes.
retry_policy.provider_internal_retries: Pi default; session errors counted where observable; individual HTTP transport retries not instrumented.
retry_policy.judge_retries: No automatic retry in extension driver; any manual judge retry must preserve previous evidence.

mistral_accounting.scope: Mistral direct attempts plus successful OpenRouter replacement for ticket 0874
mistral_accounting.pricing: Proportional allocation of native EUR39.77 invoice by token category; later runs estimated at frozen calibrated rates

invoice_calibration.scope: Native Mistral completed attempts before the new 0211/0874/1372 direct retries; OpenRouter excluded
invoice_calibration.allocation: Per token category, invoice amount times run tokens divided by measured campaign tokens. Frozen denominator; future runs estimated at calibrated rates.
invoice_calibration.note: Author console token counts are rounded; measured counters are used to conserve EUR39.77 exactly across the frozen campaign.

mistral_accounting.ideal: Latest judged successful run per ticket
mistral_accounting.real: All completed attempts summed per ticket, best successful quality

attempt_audit.scope: All preserved attempts for the ten sampled tickets, including invalid infrastructure and wrong-base attempts. Mistral includes both providers for counts; token means follow the runs used for each graph series. Counts are not pure model reliability.
